key_concepts: A horizontal line on a distance-time graph means the object is not moving
A curved upward distance-time graph indicates increasing speed and acceleration
Uniform acceleration produces a parabolic distance-time graph
Slope describes the steepness of a line
The x-axis is horizontal and the y-axis is vertical
An object moving with constant speed and direction is not accelerating
Uniform acceleration means velocity changes at a constant rate, not constant velocity
A velocity-time graph plots time on the x-axis and velocity on the y-axis
The slope of a velocity-time graph gives acceleration
A horizontal line on a velocity-time graph indicates constant velocity and zero accelerati
Positive and negative acceleration produce opposite sloping velocity-time graphs
